none.info_panel_subtitle:
The objective of this platform is to allow decision makers to monitor the state of agriculture by performing cross-analysis on multiple dimensions: temperatures, water access, crops extent, population dynamics, etc.

You can start navigating by selecting a theme and an indicator in the left panel, and then a region on the map.
none.info_panel_disclaimer: Note: The data for 2025 is provisional and should be compared with caution against previous years, as it represents an incomplete year and may not fully reflect annual trends.

ndvi.left_panel_tooltip: Monitored by the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) at 250m resolution
ndvi.info_panel_subtitle: The Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) is an accurate indicator of vegetation health and density. Its values are between -1 and 1: an area with little to no vegetation will have an NDVI value close to 0, while an area with dense and healthy vegetation will have values closer to 1. Water bodies will yield an NDVI value close to -1.
ndvi.source: Source: Terra MODIS NDVI data MOD13Q1 v061

cropmask.left_panel_tooltip: Displays the areas that are likely to be cultivated based on their NDVI values.
cropmask.info_panel_subtitle: The crop mask was obtained by applying a threshold on the NDVI at the peak of the crop growth cycle. It displays areas that are likely to be cultivated, as it filters out low density or unmaintained vegetation patches.
cropmask.source: Source: Calculated using Terra MODIS NDVI data

waterlevels.left_panel_tooltip: Levels of water in main lakes and resevoirs, derived from satellite observations. The radius of the circles encode the average level of the corresponding lake or reservoir for the selected year.
waterlevels.info_panel_subtitle: Water levels derived from satellite observations expressed in meters above the sea level.
waterlevels.source: Source: Database for Hydrological Time Series of Inland Waters (DAHITI)

waterextent.left_panel_tooltip: Occurence of water monitored with satellite image at 300m resolution.
waterextent.info_panel_subtitle:
Water occurence, shown in percentage

Detects the percentage of occurence of water accross multiple satellite observations. Some area may be missing due to the presence of clouds during the satellite image acquisition.
waterextent.source: Source: Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) Water Bodies v2

precipitations.left_panel_tooltip: Provided by the CHIRPS dataset with a 5km resolution
precipitations.info_panel_subtitle:
Cumulated precipitations, shown in millimeters.

The CHIRPS dataset gives accurate rainfall estimations from rain gauge and satellite observations with a 5km resolution. The data presented here is the cumulated rainfall (in mm) over the year.
precipitations.source: Source: Climate Hazards Infrared Precipitation with Stations (CHIRPS)

temperature.left_panel_tooltip: Provided by the MODIS Land Surface Temperature dataset with a 5km resolution
temperature.info_panel_subtitle:
Temperature is shown in degrees Farenheit.

The temperature data was drawn from MODIS datasets, which map the average daytime temperature with a resolution of 5km. The data presented here is the average daytime temperature over the year.
temperature.source: Source: MODIS/Terra Land Surface Temperature MOD21C3 v061

population.info_panel_subtitle:
Distribution of the population, expressed as the number of people per 1ha.

Residential population estimates are derived from a raw global census data. This data has been harmonized and disaggregated to grid cells, informed by the distribution, classification and volume of built-up as mapped in the GHSL global layers.
